SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25002060
DOCKET NO. F143024
PLAINTIFF – TEAM 3 FINANCIAL, LLC
DEFENDANTS- 125 BERCHMAN ST LLC; NAYANA PATEL and JAMES E. SHELTON
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 20th DAY OF May 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of PLAINFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: TAX LOT 31 BLOCK 328
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
125-27 BERCKMAN STREET PLAINFIELD, NJ 07062
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: PROPERTY TO BE SOLD IS LOCATED IN: City ofP1ainfie1d, county ofUnion, in the State of New Jersey.
TAX LOT:
Block 328, Lot 31 NEAREST CROSS STREET:
E. Front Street
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS :
Lot Size is Approx. 4,982 sq. ft.;
Living Area is Approx. 1,248 sq. ft A full legal description can be found at the Office of the Register
Taxes and Other Encumbrances:
Tax Sale Certificate 24-0042 (redemption amount through 8/31/25 is approximately $26,000.00)
Taxes Due Q3 2025 in the amount of $1,776.35
Water/Solid Waste Due for 08/02/25 in the amount of $$301.55
*Plus Interest and/or penalties on these figures through date of payoff and any and all subsequent taxes, water and sewer amounts.
Upset Price: $335,000
Occupancy Status: It is believed that the property is occupied by tenants.
SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF SALE AS SET FORTH BY THE SHERIFF WHO RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THE SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.
ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS OF SALE: SUBJECT TO
All municipal in the office of the Tax Collector for City of Plainfield, including Tax Certificate 24-0042 sold 11/15/24, in the amount of $9,633.08, and all subsequent charges, penalties and interest thereon.
2. The rights, if any, of any tenants or occupants of the property.
3. Any conditions or issues that may be revealed by an examination, inspection or survey of the property.
4. All facts that may be revealed by a title search of the property.
5. Any issues or conditions that may be revealed by an examination of the public record, including any easements or restrictions of record.
6. Any required building or housing code inspections, approvals, certificates or penalties.
7. All municipal* county, state and federal rules, regulations, ordinances, laws, zoning or statutes.
8. The property is being sold in "as is" condition, with all faults and defects.
SURPLUS MONEY: IF AFTER THE SALE AND SATISFACTION OF THE MORTGAGE DEBT, INCLUDING COSTS AND EXPENSES, THERE REMAINS ANY SURPLUS MO
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $331,590.82 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
